# UPchieve Changelog, week of Nov 14 to Nov 21, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Nov 20, subway Nov 20. These deploys carried the DM, coach status, coach queue, live media ban, graffiti, and survey work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- 🚀 **Show every student whether their past coaches are online, and what each coach chose to share:** a dot and label on each coach's card for online, in a session, or offline ([high-line !2054](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2054)); coaches choose whether students see it, as one more item in what they share ([subway !3185](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3185), [subway !3187](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3187), [high-line !2103](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2103)), on by default for adult coaches, like everything else they share ([high-line !2138](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2138)); a hover card on each coach's avatar with what they share ([high-line !2068](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2068)); the dashboard modal that asks coaches what students see, after their first session ([high-line !2058](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2058), [subway !3142](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3142), [subway !3143](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3143)); hours tutored rounded to whole hours and evenly spaced stats on the Meet your coach card, and "any time" in the modal ([high-line !2131](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2131)). On for every student and coach since Nov 16 ([`show-coach-status`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039508), [`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424)). *Liseidy Bueno, Alex Rodriguez*
- **Moderate DMs the way session chat is moderated:** 🧪 each DM records whether the student sent it while shadow banned, coaches don't receive those, and coaches can't message a shadow-banned student ([subway !3167](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3167), [subway !3178](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3178)); 🧪 subway refuses that message too, even to a student shadow banned mid-conversation ([subway !3181](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3181)), and coaches see a tooltip that doesn't say why ([high-line !2091](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2091)); 🧪 students can't message or request a session with a banned coach, and a tooltip tells them so ([subway !3206](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3206), [high-line !2125](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2125)); 🚀 admin's Session Review is now Safety Review and lists flagged and reported DMs, as the safety team's backup to its review in Retool ([subway !3191](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3191), [high-line !2106](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2106)). The student and coach parts roll out with DMs ([`direct-messages`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039499)). *Liseidy Bueno, Trey Stevens*
- 🧪 **Give each coach-student pair one DM thread, apart from session recaps:** filters on My Coaches for favorite coaches, as a chip, and for unread DMs ([high-line !2094](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2094)); filters on coaches' Messages page by student name and unread DMs ([high-line !2095](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2095)); a sort menu on both pages with A to Z, where two people with the same name go most recent session first, and the unread filter as a chip like favorites instead of a dropdown ([high-line !2119](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2119)); session chat's "please be respectful" reminder under the DM chat box ([high-line !2097](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2097)), now one safety notice component both chats use ([high-line !2109](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2109)). DMs reach half of students and every coach ([`direct-messages`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039499)), and the Messages link is in every coach's sidebar ([`turn-messages-on-for-coaches`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1088489)). Since Nov 16 that includes the unread dots, the DM panel with its star and Request session button, and coaches' Messages link from earlier weeks ([high-line !2060](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2060), [high-line !2070](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2070), [high-line !2090](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2090)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🧪 **Text a requested coach only during their availability.** Coaches with no availability set still get the text, since many newer coaches haven't set any but pick up sessions from the dashboard. Requesting a coach reaches 60% of students with at least one session ([`student-request-specific-volunteer-sessions`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/713196)). ([subway !3196](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3196)) *Trey Stevens*

## Coach queue

Revise the request dispatch algorithm to offer a new session to a few coaches one at a time, the way a library hold list runs down, before it goes to every coach online. Earlier digests called this Session holds.

- **Let coaches join a queue to be matched with students one at a time:** 🚀 a Join queue button above the session list for coaches ready to tutor, counting how long they've waited and reading "Leave queue" on hover, hidden during a session, with a toast when a coach is taken out: "We took you out of the queue due to inactivity. Join again whenever you're ready." ([high-line !2099](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2099), [high-line !2117](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2117), [high-line !2124](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2124)); 🚀 only coaches in the queue are scored and offered sessions, by their time in the queue instead of time online, and they drop out after 20 seconds offline or inactive ([subway !3182](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3182)); 🚀 subway marks a passive coach inactive when a session they could take is listed for everyone and they don't come back within a minute, instead of high-line checking from a tab the browser may have paused ([subway !3190](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3190)); 🚀 switching to Student mode asks first, then takes the coach out of the queue ([high-line !2122](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2122), [subway !3200](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3200)); 🚀 coaches go back into the queue when their session ends ([subway !3202](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3202), [high-line !2120](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2120)); 🚀 only coaches online as coaches can join ([subway !3209](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3209)); 🚀 practice sessions are never offered ([subway !3184](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3184)); 🚀 the offer alert becomes one of the new request cards ([high-line !2100](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2100)); 🚀 PostHog events for joining and leaving the queue ([subway !3204](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3204), [high-line !2123](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2123)); 🎁 the join call returns when the coach joined, for queue UI to come ([subway !3216](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3216)); ✅ high-line stops asking subway to run the inactivity check ([high-line !2104](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2104)); 👀 one event each time a coach joins, so every device they're signed in on shows them in the queue ([subway !3211](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3211), [subway !3212](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3212), [high-line !2132](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2132)). Requests from every student go to the queue first ([`session-offers`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1031506)), and every coach has it except FWS and America Counts tutors and a long-term holdout of 10% ([`session-offers-coach`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1036651)). *Jamie Kasulis, sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Swap the blue arrow on each session row for a grey caret.** ([high-line !2105](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2105)) *Jamie Kasulis*

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Redesign Chapter HQ's header and Home:** a header with the chapter's status (Pending, Official, or Official in Good Standing, which adds 40 hours tutored this school year), a Copy invite button beside the chapter name, and the tabs as pills ([subway !3208](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3208), [high-line !2130](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2130)); an impact card whose "This school year" tab puts hours on a ruler against the 40-hour goal, with students and sessions beneath, and whose "All-time" tab shows total hours as digit tiles ([high-line !2133](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2133), [high-line !2134](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2134)); a Top members board in place of Top tutor of the month, ranking up to three members by hours this school year, ties going to more sessions, with the viewer marked "(you)" and told how much more tutoring moves them up ([high-line !2136](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2136), [subway !3215](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3215)); a "Your contribution" card for members, splitting the chapter's hours between theirs and everyone else's against the 40-hour goal, and a "Chapter goals" card for admins in place of Good standing ([high-line !2139](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2139)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Mark chapters official by the members-tutoring count Chapter HQ shows:** the hourly job reads that count for the current school year, no longer stops after Dec 31, and leaves out members who aren't onboarded and approved, while chapters already official stay official ([subway !3205](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3205)); the Official chapter email shows how many members are tutoring ([subway !3207](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3207)). *Ben Wheeler, Kasozi Wilson*
- 🧪 **Let high school students join NTHS's at-large chapter from the volunteer hours page,** to see whether students want to join as members and not only as presidents: the Honor Society version of the page has NTHS copy, logo, and benefits, and its Join NTHS button makes the student a coach and an at-large member in one step, then starts coach onboarding ([high-line !2101](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2101), [subway !3188](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3188)); students with no grade are asked for it first ([high-line !2118](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2118)), and students not in high school are told that's why they can't join ([subway !3201](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3201)). The page is split 60/40 between the Honor Society version and the current one, for high school students and for students with no grade outside 46 partner schools ([`show-student-to-volunteer-hours-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/706824)). *Kasozi Wilson*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🚀 **End each e2e student's sessions after every test, pass or fail.** A failed chat test left its student's request open, so every coach who signed in later got a "needs help" toast; on Mobile Chrome it covered the member menu and failed another MR's e2e job. ([high-line !2081](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2081)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Component library

Pulling high-line's presentation components out of the components that handle data, so non-engineers can change how the app looks without affecting how it works.

- 🚀 **Lint the presentation components for hand-written design values.** stylelint on `src/components/PresentationComponents/` only: colors, spacing, radius, fonts, and transitions there must use a variable or mixin from `src/scss/setup`, checked on pre-commit and in CI. ([high-line !1998](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1998)) *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🎁 **Stop sending email to domains on the blocklist.** Accounts on a fake domain exist before we block the domain, so regular emails kept going to them and erroring in SendGrid. Single and bulk sends skip blocked domains now. ([subway !3220](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3220)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Lift a live media ban from the current partner, not the last one.** Remove Ban cleared the ban on the partner from an earlier session, because the client sent a stale session id. subway works out the caller's current partner itself now, and high-line stops sending the session id. 🐛 [#738](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/738) ([subway !3175](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3175); [high-line !2086](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2086)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Keep America Counts coaches out of sessions a student requested for another coach.** Auto-join didn't check whether a session was reserved, so these coaches saw a pop-up that it was requested for someone else, then got sent back into it from the dashboard, over and over. [#764](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/764) ([high-line !2129](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2129)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🚀 **Keep the "student needs help" toast off session pages, and show it for 15 seconds instead of 2 minutes everywhere.** After a session ended it covered the chat box while the coach was still replying. The sound and browser notification still fire. ([high-line !2127](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2127)) *Macy Lam*
- 🚀 **Send coaches to the dashboard when the subject has no post-session survey.** Practice Session has none, so ending one left the coach's feedback page loading forever. ([high-line !2107](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2107)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Size the onboarding modal's buttons to their labels.** They were cut off to "Previ…" and "Get st…" for every new student and teacher. ([high-line !1860](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1860)) *Iulia Rontu*
- 🚀 **Allow one survey context per survey, subject, and survey type.** AP Geography had two, so its post-session feedback form showed every answer twice: ten stars, two rows of faces, and two yes/no answers on the safety question. ([subway !3186](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3186)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Upgrade subway to Node 24.22.3 to patch [a use-after-free bug in Node](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-UPSTREAM-NODE-22469231) (CVE-2026-123864).** high-line got it last week. ([subway !3179](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3179)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Run graffiti in local dev and e2e, and point the whiteboard at it.** Local dev and e2e couldn't reach graffiti, so e2e whiteboards ran on the old server. graffiti joins the dev and e2e compose profiles, and the whiteboard reads its server from `VUE_APP_ZWIBBLER_COLLAB_SERVER_ROOT`, which existed but nothing read. ([subway !3171](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3171); [high-line !2084](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2084)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Read the Google Play credentials from the right CI variable** in high-line's Android build. ([high-line !2102](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2102)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🎁 **Issue a short-lived whiteboard token to the people in a session,** so graffiti, which accepts any connection today, can check who joins a room. `POST /api/session/:sessionId/whiteboard-token` checks that the caller can access the active session and sets the token as a cookie. [#731](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/731) ([subway !3193](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3193), [subway !3195](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3195)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 👀 **Make people prove they own an existing UPchieve account before Clever or ClassLink links to it.** SSO sign-in failed when a student already had an account with that email but hadn't verified it: they sign in first, with their password or a code emailed to them ([subway !3057](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3057); [high-line !2015](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2015)); students a teacher rosters from Clever who haven't linked yet show grayed out in the teacher's class, with a tooltip, until they sign in ([subway !3210](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3210), [subway !3217](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3217), [subway !3218](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3218), [subway !3219](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3219); [high-line !2137](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2137)). 🐛 [#748](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/748) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Let people in Puerto Rico and other US territories sign up.** Puerto Rico wasn't accepted as part of the United States. subway accepts American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands ([subway !3194](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3194)), and SMS verification takes their phone numbers ([high-line !2108](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2108)). 🐛 [#735](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/735) *sammy nave*
- 👀 **Load PostHog flags for a signed-in user under their own ID.** A signed-in user with no PostHog cookie got flags for a random ID first, so their first events carried flag values their account shouldn't have. ([subway !3198](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3198); [high-line !2114](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2114)) *Trey Stevens*

### Internal tools
